snippet.title: Pac-Man 99 Deluxe Pack DLC! - New Modes: CPU Battle, Score Attack and Blind Time Attack
snippet.description:
Pac-Man 99 Deluxe Pack DLC! - New Modes: CPU Battle, Score Attack and Blind Time Attack

In this Video of Pac-Man 99 Gameplay, I show you the Full Version of the Game, you can get on the Nintendo Switch eshop if you buy the Deluxe Pack. Pac Man 99 is a new nintendo switch game with uses Nintendo Switch Online just like Tetris 99 and super Mario Bros 35. If you get the Deluxe Pack you get 20 Themes, and all offline Modes, as well as the option to create Private Matches. If you purchase the Deluxe Pack for $30 you get CPU Battle, Score Attack and Blind Time Attack. In this Video I will show you Gameplay of all modes, so you can decide if it is worth the money for you. If you enjoy the Video don't forget to like it and subscribe to my channel.
